Reverb Acquisition Partnership · Fund I

Bridging the Gap

RAP Fund I acquires and scales a portfolio of durable, cash-flowing music catalogs overlooked by large institutional capital.

Investor overviewSeptember 2026
01 The strategy

From a songwriter’s income
to an institutional asset

We win below the institutional radar

Combining the sophistication of a large institutional buyer with the relationships, flexibility, and knowhow required to source and execute smaller, complex deals.

Repeatable drivers of value

01 / Source

Access opportunities through trusted relationships with labels, publishers, songwriters, attorneys, and managers.

02 / Curate

Select catalogs using decades of publishing and frontline music industry experience.

03 / Diligence

Evaluate each income stream and resolve legal and financial complexities.

04 / Exit at scale

Deliver diversified, institutional-ready libraries to long-term investors.
